# Jobby

Jobby does not authorize automated scraping, bulk extraction, dataset creation,
model training, or retrieval-augmented ingestion of private application routes,
user data, CVs, job reports, billing screens, dashboards, or API responses.

Allowed for ordinary indexing:
- Public landing page
- Public pricing page
- Terms and privacy pages

Disallowed for AI crawlers and automated agents:
- /api/
- /dashboard/
- /profile/
- /jobs/
- /ats/
- /reality-gap/
- /interview-kits/
- /wizard/
- /billing/
- Uploaded documents, CVs, generated reports, match scores, interview kits,
  profile data, billing data, and authenticated user content.

Contact: contacto@jobby.ai
